title: Census 2011 district code sidecar lookup
description: Authoritative LGD-district -> Census-2011 district-code lookup map produced by tools/boundaries/enrich_census_code_2011.py. Read at boundary-emit time to merge `census_code_2011` into each district feature's properties so Census-2011-keyed datasets join without per-consumer crosswalk code. Lives at datasets/boundaries/in/districts/census_code_2011.json. Keys are stringified LGD district codes (matching the `dist_lgd` feature property on datasets/boundaries/in/districts/all.{geojson,topojson}). Values are the Census 2011 numeric district codes (per the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner's 2011 district directory) or null where the LGD district has no Census 2011 equivalent (post-2011 bifurcations like Telangana 2014, Ladakh 2019, Tamil Nadu Mayiladuthurai 2020). Source topology: data-analytics.github.io/Choropleth_India_Map/map.json (641 features carrying `censuscode` + `st_cen_cd` + `st_nm` + `district` properties; itself a Census 2011 derivative).

x-changelog.description: Initial schema. PR-3 of TODO/20260611-elections-off-maplibre-and-map-ux-plan.md. Authority: Hans + Max (user pre-approved). The new `census_code_2011` boundary feature property closes the citizen-facing gap where Census-2011-keyed indicators (Census demographics, SECC-2011, NFHS-4 etc.) had to carry their own LGD<->Census-2011 crosswalk.

by_dist_lgd.description: Map keyed by stringified LGD district code -> Census 2011 numeric district code (integer 1-640) or null. Every LGD district in datasets/boundaries/in/districts/all.geojson MUST appear as a key; null is the documented sentinel for `Census 2011 had no equivalent district`. Keys are stringified to match JSON-object semantics (integer keys are not valid JSON). The key `0` is reserved for the LGD sentinel that the upstream uses to ship POK (Pakistan-administered Kashmir) districts which were never in India's Census enumeration; that entry carries null.
